actual_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: clean transparent production sprite animation, complete24cel recover clip.
Input image1 role: FOUR KEY POSES ONLY in a2x2 reference, NOT the output sheet layout. Top-left=start frame0, top-right=frame8, bottom-left=frame16, bottom-right=end frame23.
Subject: DELAYED SHADOW: the thin ivory-masked insect duelist with two long dark swept head horns, a dark navy/blue-black ragged feather-wing cloak with small worn gold accents, TWO vivid crimson scarf ribbons streaming behind, dark thin legs and the slender gray rapier/needle when shown. Keep this exact identity and red scarf. Draw ONE opaque character per cel, no duplicated shadows, afterimages, blur or ghosts.
Request: draw24 separately authored consecutive animation cels interpolating those FOUR key poses through natural body/limb/wing movement. The OUTPUT is6columns x4rows, NOT2x2. Populate all24 cells in row-major order.
Motion: A continuous recovery: ease the body out of the action, settle the wing/cloak/tendrils and finish in the calm loop stance shown in the final cel. Use small coherent changes, no rapid alternating body orientations.
Frame0 must match the first key's body/head position, silhouette size and equipment. Frame8 should approach the second key, frame16 the third, and frame23 must match the final key closely, including its position and body lean. Fill the intervals with small coherent changes and gradual rotations. Do not suddenly flip between front and side views on alternate frames. This is ONE continuous motion; do not reset at row boundaries. Every cel must be a distinct real pose.
Physical invariants: ONE constant body mass, head size and rig anchor across all24 cels. The reference includes the precise existing costume, palette, equipment and planted/hovering position. Keep them, including saturated accent markings. Preserve each key's sprite-to-cell size and positioning; do not enlarge sprites to fill cells. Keep a clean gutter of at least16transparent pixels around every cel.
Style: exact crisp dark ink outlines and opaque painted2D sprite material from the reference. Restrained shading, clear anatomy and fine costume details. No cartoon redesign, smeared edges, image blur, copied identical frames, extra limbs/props, duplicated weapons, ghost poses or afterimages.
Output canvas:1536x1024 pixels, exactly6 equal columns x4 equal rows, transparent RGBA. Actual alpha zero in all empty space. Only the character pixels are painted. No background color, cast shadows, glow halo, haze, ground, scenery, checkerboard, panel lines, words, labels, numerals or watermark. Any luminous core is an opaque painted shape inside its crisp outline; no surrounding mist. No detached projectiles, sparks or attack effects.
